builds.name: Mixed Phase
builds.desc: It's a high investment build. Thanks to the Atk/Spd Push 4 this build provides a huge damage during both phases, instead of just during player phase, like most common skills (Swift Sparrow, Death Blow, etc...). Also, the counterpart of that skill (5 damage yourself) make it easy for Hana to get into Wrath's threshold, which is going to add an extra +10 pure damage in combat, together with a 1 CD reduction on the next turn since you reach the requisite. Which takes us to the reason why I picked "Moonbow": thanks to Hana's native Speed you're going to use the Special (plus the +10 dmg) on every fight since you're on Wrath threshold.
